verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a v2 REST API at rest.ripplingapis.com, Bearer token auth, dated version pinning, pagination, an npm SDK, an llms.txt file and an MCP server. None of it mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. llms.txt is documentation, and the SDK and MCP server are separate capabilities, so neither counts as an API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
